strategy "Sideways_Breakout_Reference_Cooldown" {
    timeframe = "5m"
    range_period = 20
    atr_period = 14
    range_atr_multiplier = 5.0
    sideways_confirm_bars = 3
    escape_window_bars = 10
    cooldown_bars = 6
    trend_fast_period = 20
    trend_slow_period = 60
    range_high = ta.highest(high, range_period)
    range_low = ta.lowest(low, range_period)
    range_width = range_high - range_low
    atr_value = ta.atr(atr_period)
    range_atr_ratio = range_width / atr_value
    sideways_raw = range_atr_ratio <= range_atr_multiplier
    sideways = state.persist(sideways_raw, sideways_confirm_bars)
    previous_range_high = ta.highest(high[1], range_period)
    upward_escape = close > previous_range_high
    recent_sideways = state.hold(sideways, escape_window_bars)
    reference_bar = state.edge(recent_sideways and upward_escape)
    reference_high = ta.value_when(0, reference_bar, high)
    reference_low = ta.value_when(0, reference_bar, low)
    breakout = ta.crossover(close, reference_high)
    trend_fast = ta.ema(close, trend_fast_period)
    trend_slow = ta.ema(close, trend_slow_period)
    trend_ok = trend_fast > trend_slow and close > trend_slow
    long_exit = ta.crossunder(close, reference_low)
    reentry_ready = state.ready_after(long_exit, cooldown_bars)
    long_entry = not sideways and trend_ok and reentry_ready and breakout
    short_entry = false
    short_exit = false
    on(long_entry) { order.buy(type = "MARKET") }
    on(long_exit) { order.close_long() }
}
